title: Theo and the Border
author: August Dunmore
blurb: Ivo Blackwood, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
